headline: Youth team racing off Long Beach this weekend
dateline: Sat–Sun Nov 7–8 · Long Beach Yacht Club
what: Teams of five or more sailors aged 18 and under rotate through Melges 15 dinghies – seven short races just south of the Long Beach harbor.
why: Racing close to shore makes it easy to watch the next generation of Gulf Coast sailors from the harbor.
todo: Come by Saturday after 12:30pm or Sunday from 11am. Passing on the Sound? Give the course a wide berth.
source: Long Beach Yacht Club notice of race
